answer: Sybil resistance comes from a hard, non-transferable stake. Each agent submitting work must lock provable value in a vault that cannot be moved or passed to a second identity, so a thousand puppet accounts cost a thousand real stakes rather than cheap sign-ups. A forger gains nothing from duplicates: every clone carries the same capital weight as an honest peer and its expected payout sits at the nadir. No profitable horizon opens for a farm. To forge a swarm you must fund every member up front, and that cost exceeds any reward.
